subject: Money
title: Subscription Creep
description: A short lesson to help you apply Subscription Creep.

hook.text: Americans spend $219/month on subscriptions on average. Most underestimate by 2-3x.

buildup.text: Each subscription is small: $10 here, $15 there. Individually harmless. Collectively devastating.

discovery.text: Subscriptions exploit present bias: the monthly cost feels tiny compared to the annual total.

twist.text: Companies count on inertia. Most people don't cancel because the hassle seems worse than the cost.

climax.text: Subscriptions turn one buying decision into indefinite payments. The real price is never a single month.

quiz.question: How much do Americans spend monthly on subscriptions on average?
